name: qsandbox-desktop
description: QSandbox desktop shell (Electron) — starts the local sandbox server and renders the Vue GUI

scripts.check-sidecar: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const dist=path.join(__dirname,'..','build-sidecar','mqs.dist');if(!fs.existsSync(dist)){console.error('缺少编译好的 sidecar: '+dist);console.error('先在仓库根目录运行: python tools/build_sidecar.py');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run check-sidecar && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run check-sidecar && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run check-sidecar && electron-builder --mac dmg
